_comment: SimCC (1-D coordinate classification) on Lizard. Recipe is copied field-for-field from landmarking/config/experiments/shape_prior/lizard_heatmap_baseline.json -- the setup that produced the established ~6.5px lizard heatmap number (120 epochs, milestones [80,105], batch 32, head LR 1e-3 / backbone 1e-4, grad_clip 1.0, wd 1e-4) -- so the A/B against that config is single-variable: variant heatmap -> simcc, plus the simcc_* keys. RUN THAT CONTROL TOO rather than comparing against the older ~6.5px run, whose metrics artifact was never committed. heatmap_size 128 x simcc_upsample 4 = 512 bins per axis over the 512px canvas, i.e. ONE BIN PER CANVAS PIXEL, which is the point: the 2D heatmap family is pinned at input/4 = 4 canvas px per cell. NOTE graph_topology and flip_pairs are inert for this variant (no graph; the Lizard flip permutation comes from datasets/lizard/topology.py, and flip augmentation is governed by training.flip_prob) -- they are kept at the control's values so the two configs diff cleanly. model.sigma is likewise unused by simcc_loss; simcc_sigma is in BINS and is the one that matters.
